sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-90.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 90 was established by Ordinance No. 15236, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 2, 1976. Ordinance No. 15236 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the 1960 Revised Code of Civil and Criminal Ordinances of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 15236 was amended by Resolution No. 78-1161, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 26, 1978, and Resolution No. 84- 2427, passed by the Dallas City Council on July 25, 1984. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 15236; 25423; Res. Nos. 78- 1161; 84-2427)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-90.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 90 is established on property generally located between Cockrell Hill Road and Guadalupe Avenue, 666.5 feet north of the north line of Blue Ridge Boulevard. The size of PD 90 is approximately 5.99 acres. (Ord. Nos. 15236; 25423)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-90.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25423)

sections.title: Site Analysis Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-90.104.SITE ANALYSIS PLAN. A site analysis plan indicating the natural and man-made conditions of the site, as approved by the city plan commission, is provided as Exhibit 90A. (Ord. Nos. 15236; 25423)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-90.105.CONCEPTUAL PLAN. A conceptual plan indicating use districts by tracts, as approved by the city plan commission, is provided as Exhibit 90B. (Ord. Nos. 15236; 25423)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-90.106.DEVELOPMENT PLAN.
(a)A detailed development plan for the initial area of development and/or utilization must be submitted to the city plan commission within six months after the passage of Ordinance No. 15236, and must be approved by the city plan commission, signed by the director of development services, and attested by the chair of the city plan commission prior to the issuance of a building permit.
(b)The approved development plan must be attached to and made a part of the ordinance through resolution of the city council. Development within this PD must be in accordance with the approved development plan. The development plan approved by the city plan commission on July 25, 1984, is labelled Exhibit 90C. (Ord. Nos. 15236; 25423; Res. 84-2427)

sections.title: Ingress And Egress
sections.text: SEC. 51P-90.107.INGRESS AND EGRESS. All means of ingress and egress to this PD must be approved by the traffic design section of the department of public works and transportation. Sufficient automobile stacking space for off-street loading and unloading of students must be provided as required by the traffic design section. Vehicles entering from Cockrell Hill Road must exit onto Cockrell Hill Road, and vehicles entering from Guadalupe Avenue must exit onto Guadalupe Avenue. The loading and unloading of students is restricted to the front of the property on Cockrell Hill Road. Access to the rear of the property on Guadalupe is for emergency and service purposes only. (Ord. Nos. 15236; 25423)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-90.108.PARKING. Off-street parking must be provided for each use in accordance with the requirements of Section 20 of the Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance. (Ord. Nos. 15236; 25423)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-90.109.SIGNS. Sign placement must comply with the regulations for non-business zoning districts, as set forth in Chapter 41, "Sign Standards," of the Dallas City Code. (Ord. Nos. 15236; 25423)

sections.title: Fire Department Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-90.110.FIRE DEPARTMENT REQUIREMENTS. Fire lanes, as indicated on the conceptual plan, must be provided in accordance with the requirements of the fire department. (Ord. Nos. 15236; 25423)

sections.title: Food Preparation Facilities
sections.text: SEC. 51P-90.111.FOOD PREPARATION FACILITIES. All facilities for food preparation and service must be designed and maintained in accordance with the standards of the department of environmental and health services. (Ord. Nos. 15236; 25423)

sections.title: Uses And Academic Program
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-90.112.USES AND ACADEMIC PROGRAM.
(a)All educational structures are contained within the boundaries of Tract 3 as indicated on the conceptual plan.
(b)The maximum number of students is 250, however each category is limited to the following maximums.
(1)The maximum number of students for a day care is 100.
(2)The maximum number of students for a kindergarten is 60.
(3)The maximum number of students for a private school is 190. (Ord. Nos. 15236; 25423)

sections.title: Uses By Tract And Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-90.113.USES BY TRACT AND DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS. The permitted uses and development standards within each tract, as indicated on the conceptual plan, shall be in accordance with the following standards.
(1)TRACT I. This tract is reserved as open space only with no parking or recreation areas. Ingress and egress lanes may cross this tract. Maximum tract size is 1.21 acres.
(2)TRACT II. Use of this tract is parking and open space. No more than fifty percent of this tract will be covered with impermeable surfaces. The remainder is reserved for open space. Maximum tract size is 1.33 acres.
(3)TRACT III. Use of this tract is for day care, kindergarten, and private school from preschool through grade seven. Six parking spaces may be provided as indicated on the conceptual plan for staff and services. Recreational facilities, swimming pool for instructional purposes only, and play yards are permitted uses on this tract. Buildings must be constructed to the following standards.
(A)Maximum building area is 21,370 square feet.
(B)Maximum site coverage is 20 percent.
(C)Maximum stories is two floors.
(D)Maximum building height is 24 feet.
(E)Maximum tract size is 2.26 acres.
(4)TRACT IV. This tract is reserved for open space and recreational facilities. No building may be constructed on this tract. Maximum tract size is 0.59 acres.
(5)TRACT V. This tract is for farm livestock use, whether for recreational or for instructional purposes. The tract may be used for play areas and recreational purposes. Further development of the tract for livestock purposes must comply with Sections 10-1700 through 10-1712 of the Comprehensive General Zoning Ordinance, and with the following standards:
(A)Maximum building area is 1,764 square feet.
(B)Maximum site coverage is 10 percent.
(C)Maximum stories is two floors.
(D)Maximum building height is 24 feet.
(E)Maximum tract size is 0.60 acres. (Ord. Nos. 15236; 25423)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-90.114.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.
(a)Development of this property must be in compliance with the requirements of all departments of the city.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications adopted for such purpose to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.
(c)No certificate of occupancy shall be issued by the building official until there has been full compliance with this article in accordance with the requirements of the building for which the certificate is issued, and any applicable provisions of the zoning ordinance and the building codes. (Ord. Nos. 15236; 25423; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-90.115.ZONING MAP. PD 90 is located on Zoning Map No. N-5. (Ord. 25423)
